requirements.requirement: The system must define a board_certifications schema object containing a list of certification entries.
The system must define each certification entry to include certification_name, issuing_board, and specialty_taxonomy fields.
The system must include a relevance_score field at the measure level with a numeric value between 0 and 1.
The system must include a confidence field at the measure level with a numeric value between 0 and 1.
The system must define a specialty_mapping field that links certifications to the queried specialty using taxonomy codes or normalized strings.
The system must ensure the schema is compatible with the existing provider detail response structure without breaking existing fields.
The system must define the scoring contract such that absence of certifications results in a relevance_score of 0.
The system must define the scoring contract such that at least one relevant certification can produce a relevance_score greater than 0.
The system must ensure all schema fields have explicitly defined data types and nullability constraints.
The system must support multiple certifications per provider in the schema without data loss.
The system must handle the case where NPI credential data is missing by returning an empty certifications list and a relevance_score of 0.
The system must handle malformed or unparseable certification data by excluding invalid entries while still returning a valid schema response.
The system must ensure the schema supports downstream extension without requiring breaking changes to existing fields.
The system must define a deterministic contract for scoring outputs such that identical inputs always produce identical relevance_score and confidence values.
